comments.content: The lib check `slices.Contains(c.compilerOptions.Lib, "lib.dom.d.ts")` may not match the actual stored form of lib entries. In TypeScript, the `lib` option is stored as lowercased library keys (e.g. "dom") which are later resolved to file names like "lib.dom.d.ts". Please confirm what form `compilerOptions.Lib` actually holds here—if it contains entries like "dom" rather than "lib.dom.d.ts", this comparison will never match and the DOM suppression logic will always fire (or never fire). Consider matching the resolved lib file names or the normalized key consistently.
